title: Holomorphic functions on a class of complete Hermitian manifolds
summary: In this paper, we prove a gradient estimate for holomorphic functions on complete Hermitian manifolds with nonnegative second Ricci curvature. As an application, we establish several Liouville-type theorems for holomorphic functions and mappings between complete Hermitian manifolds under suitable curvature assumptions. In particular, on a complete Hermitian manifold with nonnegative second Ricci curvature and Chern torsion of linear growth, any bounded holomorphic function must be constant.
